reason: Evidence shows this is a DeepSeek Harness web utility focused on user-facing prompt enhancement in the chat input area: it rewrites drafts into clearer requirement lists, keeps the original text available, and restores it via undo, with a fallback path when model invocation is unavailable.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天输入框中提供一键提示词增强和撤回功能，通过按钮或 `/prompt-enhance` 指令将当前内容改写为更清晰的要求项，并可快速恢复原文。
summaries.en: This plugin adds one-click prompt enhancement with undo in the DeepSeek Harness web chat input, allowing users to rewrite a draft via button or `/prompt-enhance` and quickly restore the original text.

capabilities: Transforming user-entered chat prompt text into expanded instructions
Replacing and restoring chat input content in-place
Invoking default model path via DSH remotes with rule-based fallback

reasons.code: The plugin is described as adding a chat input button and slash command to expand current prompt text into structured requirements
It explicitly states behavior for model fallback: LLM path first, then rule-based fallback when model unavailable or timed out
Packaging metadata shows web client and DSH API remote integrations required for operation
